cohort: 2016 municipalities with all24months and six published consumption categories
annual_profile: arithmetic mean of12monthly five-category normalized profiles
annual_total: arithmetic mean of12monthly published total-category estimates; not an annual aggregate
primary_question: Do municipality-level population, wages and worker concentration add descriptive information beyond region and municipal type?
worker_concentration: log(workers/population); annual covered-organization employees divided by January resident population; not employment rate
primary_exclusions: Known economy calendar review flags; missing or nonpositive required values. No imputation.
sensitivity_exclusion: Any municipality among78with changed annual code/type
unaccepted_sources: municipal price estimates inferred from region
profile_target: CLR transform of strictly positive annual normalized profile; squared-error R2 summed over five coordinates

uncertainty.scope: paired fixed out-of-fold losses; no refitting in bootstrap

regressions: Year-specific logtotal on region/type fixed effects and3corefeatures; region-clustered covariance. Stable-code paired changes with region effects.
annual_network: Same2016cohort, profile-only distances, prior22partitiongrid; attributes used for interpretation, not input distances
prohibited_claims: income of residents from organization wage
